summary: Steven Madden, Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results, board expansion from ten to eleven members, and appointment of Kenneth Pilot as a new director effective October 1, 2026. Pilot, a retail executive, will serve on the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee and receive customary compensation. No special-situation event is involved; the filing is routine operational and governance update, with no M&A, restructuring, or activist activity. The board acted on Nominating Committee recommendation, and Pilot had prior consulting relationship. Watch for no material impact; this is standard board governance and earnings disclosure.
